Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 (npm @fortawesome/fontawesome-free@6.7.2).
css/icons.min.css is fontawesome.min.css, solid.min.css and brands.min.css joined, unchanged.
Only the solid and brands woff2 files are shipped; the .ttf fallbacks in the CSS are not.
